---
title: "Base de datos: sector"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(DT)

sector <- read_excel("Datos/sector.xlsx", sheet = 1)

idioma <- list(url = "https://cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/es-ES.json")

datatable(
  sector,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    language = idioma
  )
)
```
